latestVersion.changelog:
Polymarket-Brain v1.1 introduces a fully automated pipeline for news-driven market analysis and Discord delivery.

- Automated fetch of CNBC World Politics news, with intelligent deduplication and Discord delivery for new articles only.
- Classification of articles for expert analysis (geopolitics or macroeconomics), powering model-driven market probabilities.
- Market matching and actionable recommendation generation for eight monitored Polymarket markets based on expert/market odds divergence.
- Structured, rate-limited Discord messaging for each market and workflow summary.
- Expanded troubleshooting and installation guides, including Discord integration and common error solutions.
